newsitem.title: UK: Filtronic says US sales fall short in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Filtronic says US sales fall short in 96/97.

text.p: Filtronic Comtek Plc said on Friday a sales shortfall in its U.S. operations will likely lead to group pre-tax profits for the year to May 31, 1997 of not less than 4.0 million stg.
Filtronic, a designer and manufacturer in the cellular telecommunications industry, said U.S. sales in the second half of the current year may fall about $3 million short of its $25 million target.
The group had pre-tax profits of 3.2 million stg in the year to May 31, 1997.
Shares in Filtronic were down 8-1/2 pence at 300-1/2.
The company said in a statement, however, that the outlook for the 1997/98 financial year is "excellent".
